common.draftTranslation: Acholi text on these screens is a machine-translated draft (Sunbird AI) awaiting review by qualified speakers. Some text appears in English.
common.quickExitHint: Wek kabedo man oyot ci iwek tic
common.offline: Itye ka tic ma pe iwi yamo. Aloka-loka pe kitwero gwoko wang ma kube odwogo cen.

report.registeredNoFollow: Abili oyabo lok mo dok gitye ka tic iye. Apwoyo pi lok ma iwaco.
report.notRegisteredTitle: Abili dong gu ngiyo lok ma i coyo
report.notRegisteredBody: Tim ber ikwan lok ma aa ki bot abili i kom ngo me atima ingee ne.
report.conversationHint: In keken ki latic ma tye ka tic i kom adwogi tic ni aye twero neno kwena magi.
report.autoTranslated: Kiloko ki kompiuta — nyut gin macon
report.privacyBody: Pi ber bedo pa dano weng, coc me kwed, adwogi tic me ot yat ki coc mukene gubedo ki dul ma tye ka tic i kom lok ne. Ibino neno lok manyen, nino ma imito bedo iye ki kwena ma aa ki bot latic ni.
report.title: Wac itwa ngo ma otimme
report.intro: Ter kare ni. Itwero cung i kabedo mo keken. Pe kicwalo gin mo wang ma icwalo.
report.otherChildHint: Kibiwaci in awene ma abili otyeko tic iye, ento pe lok matut me lok pa latin meno.
report.childAge: Latin ne tye ki mwaka adi?
report.districtHint: Me lapore Kampala, Gulu onyo Wakiso. Pe mite niang lok matut i kom ot.
report.callNowTitle: Tim ber igoo cim pi kony kombedi
report.callNow: Goo cim bot Child Helpline 116 (ma pe culu) onyo abili i 999 / 112. Itwero cwalo adwogi tic man bene.
report.p1: Gin ango ma otimme, ki pud tye ka timme?
report.p2: Kama ki awene ma otimme iye.
report.p3: Latin tye agwoka kombedi? Gin mito kony me yot kom?
report.p4: Pe imito ni iwac nying ngat mo.
report.writeHint: Cooyo i leb mo keken ma itwero.
report.bothOk: Itwero mako dwan, coyo, onyo timo gin aryo weng.
report.replyLanguage: Abili omyero ogam lok ki leb mene?
report.replyLanguageHint: Kibitiro lok ma aa ki bot abili i leb man.
report.aiConsent: Tii ki Sunbird AI me niang adwogi tic ma atye ka miyo oyot
report.aiConsentHint: Lok ma iwaco ki coc ma icoyo kicwalo maber bot Sunbird AI, tic me Uganda ma tiyo i kom leb ki diro me tet, me loko lok ma ki waco odok coc, gonyo ne ki yubu lok macek pi abili. Abili pol kare ngiyo ne. Ka pe iketo alama iye, abili obi winyo onyo okwan adwogi tic ni atir — twero tero kare mo manok.
report.whatNext: Latic pa abili obi ngiyo adwogi tic ma imiyo ki obi gamo lokki i cawa 24 i leb {language}. Ibino neno lagam ne i pot buk me gang.
report.thanksBody: Ripot mamegi tye ki bot abili. Tim ber ikur — abili mo bidwogo cen boti i ngee cawa 24 i {language}.
report.answerBy: Ibiwinyo ki botwa i nino dwe {date}
report.toDashboard: Cit i pot buk me gang na
report.waitTitle: Tim ber ikur — abili tye ka ngiyo lok ma i miyo
report.waitBody: Latic mo ma tiyo ki {language} obi gamo lokki i ngee cawa 24. Pe omyero itim gin mo kombedi.
report.anyMoment: Lagam ma kigeno i cawa mo keken
report.needsInfoTitle: Abili tye ki lapeny mo pi in
report.needsInfoBody: Tim ber iyab ripot mamegi ci igam lagam wek abili omede anyim.
report.registeredFollow: Abili oyabo lok mo. Kombedi itwero lubu yoo weng ma tye piny kany.

voice.hint: Lok ki cwiny ma opye. Itwero mako lok pi dakika 3.
voice.saved: Lok ma ki mako i dwan tye atera
voice.micDenied: Pe watwero tic ki mic. Tim ber iye ni mic oti, onyo coo ododo ma imito lok iye.
voice.fallback: Kwedo lok megi pe twero mako kany. Itwero mako ki dwon me cim ma itye kwede ki iyero pwail ne.
voice.tooLarge: Gin ma ki mako ni dit tutwal. Tim ber igwok ne pe okato dakika 3.

dashboard.intro: Kany itwero lubu ripot megi ki lok ma mako komi. Pot buk man nongo tye ka ngeyo pire kene.
dashboard.newReport: Miyo ripot i kom gin manyen
dashboard.reportsInReview: Lok ma abili tye ka ngiyo

attendees.CHILD: Latin omyero obin (ki dano madit ma gene)

ben.intro: Kany itwero lubu kit ma lok megi tye ka wot kwede i leb ma yot. Ngec ma latic ma konyi otyeko ngiyo keken aye kinyutu.

q.attend: Tye gin mo ma amito bedo tye iye?

ben.noCases: Pe tye gin mo me nyutu
ben.noCasesHint: Latic ma konyi obi waci ikare ma itwero lubu lok mo kany.
ben.timelineHint: Latic ma konyi aye ongiyo kwena magi.
ben.noAppointments: Pe tye gin mo me cito iye kombedi.
ben.noConnected: Pe tye tic mo ma kicoyo
ben.emergency: Goo cim me Child Helpline 116 (ma pe culu) onyo abili i 999 / 112.
ben.safetyTitle: Bedo ki kuc i cim man
ben.tip1: Ti ki “Quick exit” me weko pot buk oyot-oyot.
ben.tip2: Kare ducu ket cingi ka ityeko tic, tutwalle i cim ma kitiyo kwede ki jo mapol.
ben.tip3: Kibi loro in kene ingee dakika 10 ma pe itimo gin mo.
ben.tip4: Kwena ma aa ki Tuliwamu pe waco ngo ma lok ni tye iye.
ben.messagesBody: SMS mo keken ma aa ki bot wa waco ni itye ki lok manyen onyo yub me rwate. Ladit ma konyi twero loko kit ma ki kubu kwede kwedi.

help.title: Cwal kwena bot latic ma konyi
help.intro: Kwena ni cito bot latic ma tye ka tic i kom lok megi. Gubi gamo kwena kany onyo gubi kubu in maber.
help.messageHint: Pe imito coyo lok matut i kom ngo ma otimme.
help.when: Cawa maber me kube kwedi (ma ki yero)
help.whenHint: e.g. “ingee cawa apar wiye aryo me dye-ceng” onyo “I ceng abicel odiko”.
help.sent: Latic ma konyi ki lok enoni dong ki waco ne. Ibino neno lagam gi piny kany.
help.safetyNow: Ka itye i peko kombedi, go cim 116 onyo abili i 999 / 112. Kwac megi bene kicwalo bot latic megi macalo gin ma pire tek.

support.title: Kony me tic
support.intro: Tic me nono ma mung tye iye ma twero konyi ki jo me gangi.

welcome.title: Wajoli, {name}
welcome.body: Man obedo kabedo maber me waco ki abili ngo ma otimme i kom latin. Itwero lok i leb ni onyo coyo ne piny. Abili obi winyo dok odwoki cen boti.
welcome.ctaHint: Tero dakika ma romo 5. Itwero mako dwon i Luganda, Acholi onyo English.
welcome.step1Body: Coone lok ma iwinyo onyo coone ngo ma otimme. Pe omyero imi nying dano.
welcome.step2Body: Abili ma tye ka ngiyo ripot ni dok gamo lok i cawa 24, i leb ma in imaro.
welcome.step3Body: Ka dong kicoyo lok ni, itwero neno yoo me tic weng, nino ma tye anyim ki kony ma kiketo pi in.
welcome.privacy1: Abili ma tye ka tic i kom lok ni keken aye twero kwano onyo winyo ne.
welcome.privacy2: Winyo me dwan ni kigwoko ki coc ma pe ngene dok pe nyutu bot ngat mukene.
welcome.privacy3: Kwena ma aa ki bot wa pe waco ngo ma lok me kwed ni tye iye.

benAppointment.LEGAL_AID: Kacokke ki ngat ma konyo i kom cik
benAppointment.FOLLOW_UP: Lim ki bot latic ma konyi

assistanceType.CALL_BACK: Tim ber igoo cim ki an
assistanceType.QUESTION: Atye ki lapeny mo i kom lok ma atye kwede
assistanceType.APPOINTMENT_HELP: Kony me bedo tye i nino ma ki keto
